title: MIRAApproval
description: Defines the authorization contract for consequential, state-mutating, or high-risk tool operations on the Windows workstation.

approval_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifier for the approval request.

task_id.description: UUIDv4 of the associated parent task awaiting clearance.

user_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying the human user to whom the approval request is issued, distinct from device identity.

requested_by_device_id.description: UUIDv4 of the device that triggered or requested the task (Phone 1).

target_tool.description: The exact FastMCP tool pending execution (e.g., 'run_sandboxed_script', 'mutate_workspace_file').

action_summary.description: Clear explanation of what the consequential tool will do on the laptop.

parameters.description: Inspected arguments and payload passed to the tool, surfaced for audit and user consent.

risk_level.description: Assessed operational hazard rating of the action.

status.description: Current status of the approval request.

expires_at.description: Strict expiration time (TTL max 300 seconds). Once expired, tool execution is blocked.

decision_at.description: Timestamp when the user approved or rejected the action.

decision_by_user_id.description: UUIDv4 of the human user who authorized or rejected the decision, distinct from device identity.

decision_reason.description: Optional user notes or system justification for rejection or revocation.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the approval ticket was issued.
